electricalLimits.currentCeilingStatus: Design ceiling for source/lead qualification, not an approved energization setting or fuse choice
electricalLimits.motorStallStatus: Theoretical; prohibited as a continuous operating point

measurement: INA219 measures Vin− relative to its GND, and shunt voltage Vin+ minus Vin−. Compute current using the calibrated shunt value.

Branch downstream power is Vbus×I; upstream shunt-input power is (Vbus+Vshunt)×I. Their difference is I²R. Downstream measurements include driver loss, its power indicator and wiring effects; they are not motor mechanical output or pure lamp power.
USB-powered ESP, OLED and INA219 logic energy is outside the two branch measurements. The sum is not whole-system or battery energy.

Proposed nominal calibration: Current_LSB=0.0001A, R=0.1Ω, CAL=4096; Power_LSB=0.002W. This is register scaling, not a claimed accuracy. Use ±160mV gain and 16V bus register range; read configuration back after every reset.

Begin with 12-bit bus and shunt conversions, no averaging, and conversion-ready checks. The two quantities are sampled sequentially; dynamic error and missed transitions must be measured. Stale, overflow or failed samples must not be counted as valid energy.
E_kWh = sum(P_W × Δt_s)/3600000. Use monotonic elapsed time and an explicit gap policy; cost_INR=E_kWh×tariff. Keep signed flow separate from consumed energy if backflow is later supported.

For the initial unidirectional prototype reject negative flow as a diagnostic; do not silently clip it or claim regeneration. Estimate uncertainty from IC grade/offset/gain, shunt tolerance/drift, voltage error, timing and calibration.

Battery percentage is unavailable until usable capacity is measured at the relevant load and cutoff. 12V×Ah is nominal energy only. The website's separate 96 V vehicle parameters do not describe this bench circuit.
stages: 1. Unpowered identification: inspect exact modules and pin markings, continuity, polarity, solder joints, insulation and absence of power shorts. Match the new schedule; leave the inherited analog circuit disconnected.

2. USB-only logic: no 12 V loads. Verify 3.3 V and I2C pullups, scan 0x40 / 0x41 / 0x3C, confirm calibration/configuration and zero readings. Test both controls OFF through reset, boot and loss of USB.

3. Source and wiring qualification: choose an isolated current-limited bench source and rated connectors/conductors. Verify limiting behavior and output-capacitor discharge energy, grounding including USB/scope, and an accessible disconnect. Review all load gates before power.

4. Lamp commissioning: use the selected cut section and qualified source; choose a current limit below the qualified conductor/connector limits and only high enough for measured load current. Compare steady voltage/current/energy with a reference meter and log uncertainty.

5. Motor commissioning gate: qualify flyback loop, motor startup/current duration, rail/Out transients and source backfeed behavior, mounting and shaft guard. An experienced electronics reviewer must approve the setup before the first motor run. Never qualify it by deliberately stalling.

6. Battery revision: requires identified chemistry/model/charge voltage, prospective fault current, disconnect, reverse-polarity and transient design, fuse/holder coordination and conductor ratings. No battery connection schedule is issued here.
openDecisions: Identify existing battery chemistry, exact model, capacity, charge-voltage limits and available fault current. Battery operation remains withheld.

Specify fuse current/time curve, DC voltage and interrupting ratings; holder/contact ratings; main and branch conductors and connectors. A 12 V marking alone is insufficient. Do not buy a fuse solely from the 1 A prototype ceiling.
Select and qualify the bench supply, disconnect and wiring. Current limiting does not eliminate stored output-capacitor energy or motor backfeed/transient risk.
Review driver flyback diode orientation/current/energy and layout against actual motor waveforms. No PWM or regenerative behavior is included.

Measure total 3.3 V peripheral load with Wi-Fi active, combined I2C pullups/rise time, board temperatures and boot/off behavior. Two 10 kΩ sensor pullups appear in parallel; account for OLED pullups too.
Existing buck converter is deliberately not connected in revision B. Identify and qualify it only in a later power revision, including its common return and USB power selection.
Firmware for physical sampling/control still requires implementation, configuration review, calibration and fail-off testing; web simulator tests are not a firmware or hardware qualification.
Exact modules listed here are component candidates. The source/protection/mechanical items above must be resolved to turn this into a complete purchase and construction list.
